title: Plugin Resource Types Response Schema
description: Schema for the admin/data-access/plugin-resource-types endpoint: data-access resource types that enabled plugins add (H6).

id.description: Id of the resourceTypes lookup row, used as resource_type_id in role permissions

code.description: Lookup code of the type, as passed to the data-access check

plugin_id.description: Manifest id of the plugin that declares the type
